question: What practice and condition lead to an upward departure at death?
premises: One should remember the divine at all times while acting.
The state at death depends on prevailing qualities.
When sattva is dominant, the departing one goes upward.
inference: Constant remembrance together with dominant sattva leads to an upward departure.
plain_english: Therefore remember me at all times and fight. When sattva is predominant, the one who dissolves then goes upward.
